item.title: [ 58] TRANS DEATHS ARE REAL...FUCKING HILARIOUS
item.description:
Murders of transgender people primarily motivated by ‘intimate partner violence’ — not hate: report
https://nypost.com/2026/09/22/us-news/transgender-people-have-lower-murder-rate-than-general-population-crimes-usually-committed-by-partners-report/

Transgender people are murdered at lower rates than the overall US population — and when they are, the killer’s primary motive is usually not bias, according to a pair of researchers.

The findings, published by the right-leaning Manhattan Institute’s Vincent Lundgren and Colin Wright earlier this year, seemingly debunk claims by the Human Rights Campaign (HRC) and other nonprofit organizations that there is an “epidemic” of deadly violence against the trangender community driven by “transphobia” and even “white supremacy.”

“Transgender people are less likely to be murdered than the rest of the population, most transgender people are murdered by members of their own race, and intimate partner violence — not hate — is the leading identified motive for most such murders,” Lundgren and Wright found.

The researchers investigated more than 300 murder cases dating back to 2015 where the victim was transgender.

In the cases where suspects were identified, black suspects accounted for 65% of perpetrators, while white suspects accounted for 18%.

“This finding is not the result of one bad year or a handful of outlier cases,” the researchers stated.

The report noted that in 2020 — the year HRC attributed the deaths of “our Black trans siblings” to “an epidemic of violence” fueled by “systems of white supremacy” — not a single white suspect was identified in the cases the Manhattan Institute researchers verified.

Confirmed hate crimes were only found in 3.3% of cases the Manhattan Institute studied.

item.title: [ 42] Protesters gather outside UN to demand an end to Iranian regime, political executions
item.description:
https://nypost.com/2026/09/22/world-news/protesters-gather-outside-un-to-demand-an-end-to-iranian-regime-political-executions/
Thousands of anti-regime protesters gathered outside the United Nations headquarters in Manhattan on Tuesday to demand an end to Iran’s execution of political prisoners and to establish a free democracy in the country.

The demonstration, led by the National Council of Resistance of Iran (NCRI), called for world leaders at the UN General Assembly to act and force the Islamic republic to end the latest surge in executions, with at least 100 political prisoners currently on death row.

Maryam Rajavi, President-elect of the NCRI, slammed the presence of Iranian leaders, including President Masoud Pezeshkian, at the UN meeting as she and rallygoers called for an end to the current regime.

“As long as this regime remains in power, repression, executions, terrorism, and warmongering will continue,” Rajavi said in a video call-in. “The solution is regime change by the Iranian people and their organized Resistance.”

Iran has undergone an execution spree since its brutal crackdown on protesters in January, with at least 56 people hung on national security-related charges since March 19, according to the UN.

United Nations human rights chief Volker Türk warned last month that more than 100 people were facing death sentences under the regime.

Among those recently sentenced to death was Leila Abolhasani, 43, a mother of two who only filmed a retail store burning during the January protests.

item.title: [114] All major US broadcasters boycott Trump over press ban
item.description:
https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2026/09/21/politico-and-cnn-sue-trump-over-white-house-ban/

All major US TV networks are boycotting Donald Trump’s official engagements after he banned CNN from the White House.

Mr Trump said on Friday he was banning the network – along with MS NOW and Politico – shortly after he was reportedly shown clips by his aide Natalie Harp of MS NOW anchors criticising his administration on air.

The announcement apparently came as a surprise to many of Mr Trump’s advisers.

But he is known to be particularly fond of Ms Harp, who has earned the nickname of “the human printer” because she is responsible for handing him printouts of news reports or other important information.

CNN had been scheduled on Monday to be the “TV pool” camera crew, which is responsible for following the president and broadcasting his engagements to all networks.

The pooled coverage duty rotates among the major news networks, which then share the footage with each other.

CNN was removed from its pooled coverage responsibilities following Mr Trump’s ban.

But the other news networks in the pool – Fox News, NBC, ABC and CBS – decided not to provide a replacement in solidarity with CNN, marking a major escalation in the feud between Mr Trump and the media.

“The public has a vital interest in receiving accurate, independent information about its government. No administration should restrict a news organisation because it objects to its reporting,” a joint statement from the five networks said.

An email sent to TV pool subscribers on Monday said: “Effective today, the TV pool will not be covering events designated as pool coverage of the president,” according to CNN.

item.title: [125] Just in time for midterms, Trump's approval dips below 30 percent
item.description:
https://www.newsweek.com/donald-trump-approval-rating-hits-all-time-low-12467727

President Donald Trump's approval rating dropped below 30 percent for the first time across both his White House terms Monday, as the midterms draw closer.

The new poll, from American Research Group, conducted September 16-20 among 1,100 American adults, showed the president with a 29 percent overall approval rating, with positive views on the economy at 26 percent.

Overall, 72 percent of those surveyed said they felt the U.S. economy was getting worse amid rising gas and grocery prices despite the Trump administration's insistence that those pressures are still largely down to the previous administration.

By comparison, other recent polls have generally shown Trump with approval in the mid-to-high 30s, although that has differed depending on policy areas.

The last time a president's approval was in the 20s was President George W. Bush at the end of 2008, per Gallup's presidential approval tracker.

"This poll is an outlier, as others are not as bleak for the president, but overall it's pretty clear that Trump's numbers are worse now than they were eight years ago," Kyle Kondik, from the University of Virginia's Center for Politics, told Newsweek. "Dissatisfaction with the economy/inflation is probably the biggest reason why."

Newsweek reached out to the White House for comment Monday morning.

In late January, when President Donald Trump endorsed his close ally Rep. Tom Tiffany in Wisconsin’s gubernatorial race, Tiffany said he was “especially honored” and promised to “make Wisconsin great again.”

But in recent weeks, he’s taken a different tone.

Tiffany responded to Trump renaming Lake Ontario “Lake America” by declaring “the Great Lakes are the Great Lakes,” brushing aside the edict. He broke with Trump’s pro-data centers position, criticized the easing of tariffs on beef imports, and deflected questions on the president’s proposed mail-in ballot reforms that the Supreme Court blocked earlier this week. And after years of questioning whether the 2020 election was rigged against the president, including supporting an FBI probe into Wisconsin’s votes in May, he’s now taken to sidestepping the issue.

“Joe Biden won,” Tiffany said in a statement to local fact-checking outlet Wisconsin Watch earlier this month.

The rhetorical shift from such a staunch Trump ally is among a series of breaks from the president that Tiffany and other battleground Republicans have made in recent weeks. They’re an implicit acknowledgment that, even in states and districts where Republicans have had success, candidates are suffering from a deteriorating national political environment for the GOP.

item.title: [ 48] Woke NYT, 1619 Project writer deliberately sent daughter to troubled schools as a ‘sacrifice’
item.description:
https://nypost.com/2026/09/20/us-news/nyt-writer-nikole-hannah-jones-sent-daughter-to-troubled-schools-as-a-sacrifice-and-it-backfired/
The writer behind the New York Times’ controversial 1619 Project deliberately sent her daughter to poor Big Apple schools as a “sacrifice” to try to boost the education system — and no one is angrier than the kid.

The teen is now “boiling” mad — badly behind her peers after finally being allowed to enroll in a more rigorous high school, her mother revealed in a bombshell bizarre essay.

Nikole Hannah-Jones, 50, enrolled her only child in two struggling Brooklyn public schools beginning in 2015 — as part of a battle to change what she characterized as systemic racism, despite having the “connections and time and status” to get the girl into the city’s best schools, she wrote in the Times Magazine on Sunday.
“So you had money to send me to one of the best schools, and you chose not to?” the girl yelled in one fight, according to the essay. “Because other kids are disadvantaged, you didn’t want to put me in a great school?”

Hannah-Jones wrote of her decision, “We thought by sending Najya to a mostly low-income and Black school, we could help improve it for all the children there.

“We believed strongly that if families like ours went into schools like this one, it would challenge other families with similar values to do the same.

“I felt an obligation to make educational decisions based on the collective good and not just our individual advantage,” the mom said.

But after years of her daughter at the schools — PS 307 and Urban Assembly Unison, a specialty middle school — Hannah-Jones discovered her sharp-witted child lacked the basic skills to keep up in high school.


“Sometimes I wish instead of always thinking about other kids, you would have thought about me,” Hannah-Jones’ now-16-year-old daughter, Najya, said during a confrontation over the summer.

“I never really got the education I wanted.”

item.title: [180] DoorDash no longer reimburses you for completely ruined & late orders
item.description:
Even if doordash is the cause of your ruined food, they will not reimburse you for it anymore.

I order 2-3 times a day, spend thousands on DoorDash. Almost single order I’ve made for the past month has been double or triple dashed. I offer to pay my drivers extra to prioritize my order because DoorDash otherwise does not care if they deliver completely ruined food or not.

I’m a good tipper, usually $10+ before the extra tip if they’ll prioritize me.

But these days I’m being told my order is paired with a worse order before it’s even accepted by a driver.

It’s common knowledge on both sides of DoorDash that double dashes are a scam, both for the customers and the drivers.

well, today, I ordered the same thing I always do. A burger and milkshake. I message my driver as soon as he accepts, as always, and offer to tip more if they ignore double dashes. He doesn’t respond.

My order is picked up, my driver goes a few minutes down the road and sits 20+ minutes waiting on someone else’s food. Then, instead of coming here(I’m closer to him), he goes out of the way to deliver to them first. Spends 25-30 minutes driving circles around the other delivery, finally delivers it, comes here.

My order is an 45 minutes late from the original “estimated delivery”. But because the estimation will continue moving back as long as the dasher hasn’t arrived, the estimation is bs to begin with.

I contact support, explain my frustrations, show them my warm milkshake and ice cold burger.

I spent $38 (with tip) on these two items. The support agent offered me $6 in credits for food that I will not eat.

If they’ll do this to customers who spend tens of thousands every year, they’ll do it to everyone. Doesn’t matter who you are, might as well just consider your food cold before you order it cause there is no way to get your money back for DoorDash’ unfriendly consumer practices.
